Congress Protests Alleged Vote Theft in Bhopal, Clashes with Police

Congress workers protested in Bhopal on allegations of vote theft, attempting to surround the Election Commission office. Police used barricades to stop the protesters, leading to scuffles and pushing. The protest was led by Jitu Patwari, with participants wearing black clothes.
